description: The import market for a product, from government trade statistics: how much the US, UK, Canada and Germany import of its HS6 code (from China and from the world, China's share, 2024 and 2025), how many UK and Canadian companies import it, and the unit price Chile's importers declared for it from China in 2025. Each figure has its source and link. Free; does not spend a search.
name: product_market
title: Import market figures
